DescriptionSpecificationsQuestions & Answers

Blackwing pencils are ideal for illustrators and writers who prefer a soft, dark line. These Pearl pencils are crafted from incense cedar wood with a sleek, pearl-white finish. The unique rectangular white eraser can be extended as it wears down from use, and also pops out completely from the pencil body for replacement. The eraser is latex free, and replacement erasers are available in a variety of colors.

Blackwing pencils differ in the softness of the graphite core, which can be felt while writing and drawing. These pencils feature a balanced core that is smooth and dark yet holds a strong point.

These pencils were previously known as Palomino Blackwing Pencils.

# Blackwing Pearl Pencils - Set of 12
Brand: Blackwing
Category: Pencils > Wooden Lead Pencils

## Features
PENCILS WITH HERITAGE – First created in the 1930’s, Blackwing built a following that included John Steinbeck and Chuck Jones, who proudly used Blackwings to create Bugs Bunny and many other Looney Tunes characters. Discontinued in the 90’s, devotees paid as much as $40 a pencil. In 2010, we revived the Blackwing brand for a new generation of writers, musicians, and others seeking a more natural existence.; PERFECT FOR ILLUSTRATORS AND CALLIGRAPHERS – With our balanced and smooth Japanese graphite core, Blackwing Pearl pencils are perfect for illustrators, UI/UX designers, and woodworkers. Use for a line that is softer than the Blackwing 602, but firmer than the Blackwing, and all without excessive sharpening.; UNIQUE ICONIC DESIGN – Blackwing’s unique and iconic rectangular erasers are synonymous with quality. Each of our pencils features a specially designed ferrule, allowing you to extend or replace the eraser.; COMMITMENT TO QUALITY – Blackwing Pearl pencils are made with the finest materials in the world, including Genuine Incense-cedar from California and premium Japanese graphite.; HOW WE GIVE BACK – A portion of the sales from all Blackwing products benefit the Blackwing Foundation, which funds and develops arts and music education at the K-12 level. Your purchase helps provide, among other things, the instruction, learning environment and instruments children need to participate in the Little Kids’ Rock Modern Band Program.

## Pricing & Reviews
Price: 30 USD.
Rated 4.8 from 4543 reviews.
Top review: This pencil was recommended in a products review some time ago. I purchased and wanted a second boxed set of one dozen. Worth the money as it is comfortable for writing, erases beautifully, and is a pleasure to use. I still write letters and make notes with ink and pencil. The vendor was great and sent apologies for later than expected delivery. I will order again from this business.

# Blackwing - Pearl (Pack of 12)

## $40.00 

Blackwing Pearl (Pack of 12) Feature's Blackwing's Balanced graphite.

Made from California Genuine Incense-Cedar and premium Japanese graphite. Claimed by many to be the best writing pencil in the world, Blackwing pencils are famous for the quality of graphite, iconic shape, replaceable eraser, and the men and women whose works they’ve inspired throughout the years. The Blackwing Pearl features the ultimate balance in graphite core, right in between the "firm and smooth" of the Blackwing 602 and the "soft and smooth" of the Blackwing Matte. In a pearl white finish with a white eraser that is easily adjusted, extended or replaced. 

The packaging doubles as a gift box and pencil cup. The Pearl is ideal for writers, artists, and letterers who enjoy a balanced writing experience. Available in a 12-pack for artists and writers who need enough pencils to get through the day.

 G 

 Gary Wood 

Great pencil for sketching

This pencil feels great in the hand and looks good on paper. Blackwing doesn’t rate the hardness of their pencils, but I would say this compares to a 3B. It can give a pleasing range of tones for sketching, including satisfyingly dark shadows. It’s also perfectly suitable for doing crosswords in the newspaper; much more legible than a standard HB pencil.

 B 

 Brent 

It’s a Blackwing

I can honestly say that this is the best pencil I have ever used. It really is that smooth, I think next time I will try the 602 or maybe an extra firm version just to compare. But the pearl really does live up to its name. It is a beautiful tool, and will be on my restock list.

### Experiential insights by users 

 About Blackwing Pearl Pencils - Set of 12 

 Overall Feedback: 92% positive 

 89% found it smudge resistant 

 As a left-handed user, I was worried about smudging, but there has been little to no transfer to my hand. 

 88% found the sharpening process easy 

 I am satisfied with the sharpener as it works in two stages and cuts the wood down before sharpening the lead. The pencils never sharpen unevenly and the wood is always perfectly rounded. 

 The pencil's wood is harder than typical Dixon or Tombow wood and can be felt while sharpening. However, it sharpens cleanly with smooth, perfectly symmetrical wood and the graphite takes an excellent point without chipping or breaking when using a long point sharpener (Kum, highly recommended). 

 93% appreciated the lead quality, but 7% found it not ideal 

 The lead moves smoothly across the paper, leaving an even and clear line. It feels like butter spreading on hot toast with almost no friction and there is no scratchy sensation as I write. 

 The lead has a superb flow for art and is made of healthy dark graphite. 

 I found the lead to be soft and dry instead of firm and smooth as claimed. 

 89% liked the rich darkness, yet 11% felt it was dark 

 The pencil lead feels soft but is remarkably strong and dark. It can be sharpened to a razor point with very few breaks. 

 I have never seen a lead as dark as this one. It writes smoothly and has a well-designed eraser. 

 The soft, dark lead of the pencil will appeal to those who avoid lighter marks, but may pose a problem for those with vision issues. 

 The lead in Pearl pencils is just right, not too soft and not too dark. 

 68% praised the comfortable grip 

 The pencils are comfortable to grip and do not cause hand cramps while using them. 

 These pencils feel good to hold and help with my drawing flow from mind to paper. They are easy to hold and control pressure. 

 89% appreciated the clean erasability, but 11% noticed smudging 

 The pencils are not erasable cleanly, even with the best eraser, the lines will not completely come off the paper. 

 I have found that the erasers do not completely erase graphite, which is the only downside of the product. 

 84% praised the attractive design 

 I appreciate the design of the pencils, especially the matte black finish and the durable gold lettering. 

 I find the design and aesthetics of the pencils gorgeous, with a fantastic gray color and shiny gold hardware. 

 These pencils have an iconic and unique aesthetic that sets them apart from others.
